<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref, watch, onMounted } from 'vue'
const count = ref(0)
watch(count, value => {
  if (value > 10) count.value = 0
})
onMounted(() => { count.value = 1 })
function increment() { count.value++ }
</script>
<template><button @click="increment">{{ count }}</button></template>

<script setup>
import { ref } from 'vue'
const message = ref('独立组件')
function clear() { message.value = '' }
</script>
<template><button @click="clear">{{ message }}</button></template>
